Fresh citrus and a marine accord start Natural By Woods North Star, a unisex eau de parfum sold as a 100ml bottle with a 5ml travel atomiser. Its top notes are bergamot, lemon, grapefruit, vetiver, pink pepper and a marine accord, its heart grapefruit, cedarwood, labdanum, nutmeg, ginger and jasmine, and its base frankincense, ginger, New Caledonian sandalwood and amberwood.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Bergamot, lemon, grapefruit, vetiver, pink pepper, marine accord
  • Heart notes: Grapefruit, cedarwood, labdanum, nutmeg, ginger, jasmine
  • Base notes: Frankincense, ginger, New Caledonian sandalwood, amberwood

How it wears

The opening is crisp and sea-fresh, then ginger and nutmeg add spice while cedar and labdanum bring a drier, woodier feel. Frankincense and sandalwood leave a clean, slightly smoky finish. It works well in warmer weather and for daytime, the office and travel, and the woody base keeps it smart enough for an evening.

Good to know

  • 100ml eau de parfum bottle plus a 5ml travel atomiser
  • Eau de parfum
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Dusk
reviewer_notes: Primary keyword in the input is "natural by woods dawn" (wrong product); used "Natural By Woods North Star". Family label says woody; notes read fresh citrus-marine woody, which fits broadly.
